spec_match.rationale: Constructs a real Profiler against selectable workloads and reads samples/stacks/frames/resources out of the returned trace — the exact object shape the spec defines.

interactive.rationale: Workload select, duration input and the profile button produced a real trace with self-time-by-leaf-frame readouts (verified).

blurb_alignment.rationale: Nothing is a mock-up, as promised — every number is read from the returned trace.

edge_cases.rationale: Coarser-than-requested interval called out with the sample-count cross-check; missing-stack samples explained in the self-time note.

conformance.rationale: Same feature suite: sound assertions. The conformance route's missing Document-Policy header (found during this review) was fixed in routes/conformance.ts the same day; the route now serves the header and runs 4 pass / 2 fail, the fails being the marker field genuinely absent on this 153 build.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Real profile captured on this build; console and network clean; both viewports clean.

telemetry_health.rationale: profile-captured asserts the literal true; sampleCount > 0 would be falsifiable.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled select and input, aria-live outputs, visible focus 12/12.

summary: Verified on headless Chromium 153 (Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12) driven over CDP via a Playwright script — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment; desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 screenshots captured and inspected. Real traces on a page that holds the policy header; the feature-level conformance-route defect is recorded on the marker-field-probe critique.
